ائتلفوا (form VIII)
# اِئْتَلَفُوا (iʔtalafū) /iʔ.ta.la.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
# اِئْتَلِفُوا (iʔtalifū) /iʔ.ta.li.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
